The order is complete. The final page, https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html, shows "Thank you for your order!", and I left its tab open.

- **Login:** I logged in as standard_user.
- **Sort:** I sorted the products by price from low to high.
- **Cart:** I added the Sauce Labs Backpack ($29.99) and the Sauce Labs Bike Light ($9.99). The cart showed 2 items.
- **Checkout:** I checked out as Ada Lovelace, postal code 10001. The item total was $39.98, tax $3.20 and the total $43.18.

I used only the agent-browser tool.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://www.saucedemo.com && agent-browser --session $S snapshot -i
A="agent-browser --session task-68b1b8ca61e5"; $A fill @e5 standard_user && $A fill @e6 secret_sauce && $A click @e4 && $A wait --url "**/inventory.html" && $A snapshot -i
